description: Perform a mail merge in LibreOffice Writer. Open /home/ga/Documents/letter_template.docx which contains a library book renewal notice template with placeholder fields: {Name}, {Address}, {City}, {State}, {BookTitle}, and {DueDate}. A CSV data source is available at /home/ga/Documents/patrons.csv with 5 patron records. Replace each placeholder in the template with the corresponding value from each row of the CSV, creating 5 personalized letters separated by page breaks. Save the final merged output as /home/ga/Documents/merged_letters.docx.
